items.question: May I send an extract of internal records to my personal mailbox so I can work at home?
items.answer: No. Use the channel your procedure allows for that classification. A personal mailbox is not an approved store for government information.
items.source_note: Derived from departmental enquiry records (anonymised). Placeholder until the IT Security Unit supplies the real record.

items.question: The spreadsheet is not marked. Can I treat it as unclassified and forward it?
items.answer: No. Find the classification before you send it. An unmarked file is a reason to stop, not a reason to assume it is public.
items.source_note: Derived from departmental enquiry records (anonymised). Placeholder until the IT Security Unit supplies the real record.

items.question: Should I encrypt a message that leaves the government mail system?
items.answer: When the classification or the channel requires protection, yes. Use the method your B/D standard names. This hub does not pick an algorithm for you.
